summary: A quiet day: nothing on the list sold, and every price held. The new finds are a rebuilt Stihl MS660 at Bayswater for $1,300 and a 2014 John Deere 6125R with loader at Wunghnu with no price shown. Kioti is now in the tractor search; the only 90hp-plus Kioti with a loader in range is a new PX9520 without a cab at $82,995.
headlines: New: Stihl MS660 at Bayswater, 30 km, $1,300 firm, new barrel and piston, 25in bar; $799 under a new MS 462.
New: 2014 John Deere 6125R Premium, 125hp, H340 loader, 3,098 hrs, Wunghnu VIC, 220 km. No price shown, so ring for one.
First Kioti in range: new PX9520, 95hp, loader, no cab, $82,995. Over the ceiling, so it misses the top six.
New: used Warn Zeon 10-S at Swan Hill, $1,000, 340 km, control pack and remote in the photo.
Grays RBM beavertail still on its $9 opening bid with no bids; closes 22 Oct. Tottenham JD 6630 sale is 23 Oct.
Tractors over $80,000 or past 400 km now rated stretch; the 6125R and Barellan JD 6150 take their places.
